sections.content: Repository guidance requires strict separation of lifecycle, knowledge, acceptance, implementation, and publication responsibilities. Sources are hash-verified, frozen before execution, and fail closed on missing, stale, ambiguous, or drifting inputs.
sections.title: Governance

sections.content: The toolchain workflow repair plan defines W0 through W6 for typed source selection, transport, coverage, knowledge gates, immutable generations, retention, and end-to-end validation. Quick Dev owns implementation completion, while Acceptance owns acceptance completion; authorizations remain empty.
sections.title: Workflow

sections.content: All listed sources have complete single-page coverage and accepted bounded summaries. Validation requires deterministic manifests, receipts, lifecycle bindings, protected paths, explicit approvals for retention changes, and preservation of immutable pointers and historical evidence.
